```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(xgboost)
library(Matrix)
```

```{r}
infections <- read_excel("Data/Infections.xlsx")
infections$date <- as.Date(infections$date)

infections$day <- as.numeric(infections$date - as.Date("2019-11-30"))
infections$fog <- as.factor(infections$fog)
infections$thunder <- as.factor(infections$thunder)
infections$dust <- as.factor(infections$dust)
infections$smoke <- as.factor(infections$smoke)

infections$estpos <- ifelse(
  infections$posencounters == 0, 
  0, 
  (infections$posencounters / infections$restests) * infections$encounters
)
```

```{r}
lancet <- infections[, c(6, 4, 2, 20, 21, 32, 33)]

lancet <- lancet %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  mutate(
    maxtemp = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(maxtemp, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    precip  = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(precip,  k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    wind    = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(wind,    k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    pm10    = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(pm10,    k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    pm2.5   = as.numeric(scale(rollmean(pm2.5,   k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right"))),
    estpos = rollmean(estpos, k = 30, fill = NA, align = "right")
  )

lancet <- na.omit(lancet)
```

```{r}
samples <- nrow(lancet) - 120 - 10 + 1
num_features <- ncol(lancet) - 1

X <- matrix(NA, nrow = samples, ncol = 120 * num_features)
y <- numeric(samples)

for (i in 1:samples) {
  window <- as.matrix(lancet[i:(i + 119), 1:num_features])
  X[i, ] <- as.vector(t(window))
  y[i] <- lancet[i + 120 + 10 - 1, ncol(lancet)]
}
```

```{r}
test_days <- 30

train_idx <- 1:(samples - test_days)
test_idx  <- (samples - test_days + 1):samples

X_train <- X[train_idx, ]
y_train <- y[train_idx]

X_test  <- X[test_idx, ]
y_test  <- y[test_idx]
```

```{r}
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test,  label = y_test)
```

```{r}
params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric = "rmse",
  eta = 0.05,
  max_depth = 6,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

watchlist <- list(train = dtrain, test = dtest)

model_xgb <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 500,
  watchlist = watchlist,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,
  print_every_n = 20
)
```

```{r}
pred_train <- predict(model_xgb, dtrain)
pred_test  <- predict(model_xgb, dtest)

pred <- c(pred_train, pred_test)
actual <- c(y_train, y_test)
```

```{r}
eval <- model_xgb$evaluation_log

plot(eval$iter, eval$train_rmse, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Boosting Round", ylab = "RMSE",
     main = "XGBoost Training History")

lines(eval$iter, eval$test_rmse, col = "red", lwd = 2)

legend("topright", legend = c("Train RMSE", "Test RMSE"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
dates <- infections$date[lancet$day[-(1:(120 + 10 - 1))]]

plot(dates, actual, type = "l", col = "#1f77b4", lwd = 2,
     ylab = "Infections", xlab = "Day",
     main = "True and Predicted Infections (XGBoost)")

lines(dates, pred, col = "#d62728", lwd = 2)

usr <- par("usr")
xright <- max(as.numeric(dates), na.rm = TRUE)
xleft <- xright - 10

rect(xleft = xleft, xright = xright,
     ybottom = usr[3], ytop = usr[4],
     col = rgb(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.25), border = NA)

legend("topright", legend = c("True", "Predicted"),
       col = c("#1f77b4", "#d62728"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

```{r}
folds <- list()
for (i in 1:5) {
  start <- 1
  end <- length(y_train) - (5 - i) * 20
  folds[[i]] <- end:length(y_train)
}
```

```{r}
grid_A <- expand.grid(
  max_depth = c(3, 4, 5, 6), # tree depth
  min_child_weight = c(1, 3, 5), # minimum data per leaf
  gamma = c(0, 1, 3) # min loss reduction to split
)
```

```{r}
subsample = c(0.6, 0.8) # row sampling
colsample_bytree = c(0.6, 0.8) # feature sampling
```

```{r}
eta = c(0.01, 0.03, 0.05) # learning rate
```

```{r}
best_rmse <- Inf
best_params <- NULL

for (md in c(3, 4, 5, 6)) {
  for (mcw in c(1, 3, 5)) {
    for (gm in c(0, 1, 3)) {
      params_try <- list(
        objective = "reg:squarederror",
        eval_metric = "rmse",
        eta = 0.05,
        max_depth = md,
        min_child_weight = mcw,
        gamma = gm,
        subsample = 0.8,
        colsample_bytree = 0.8
      )

      cv <- xgb.cv(
        params = params_try,
        data = dtrain,
        nrounds = 1000,
        folds = folds,
        early_stopping_rounds = 20,
        verbose = 0
      )

      if (cv$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean[cv$best_iteration] < best_rmse) {
        best_rmse <- cv$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean[cv$best_iteration]
        best_params <- params_try
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric = "rmse",
  eta = 0.03,
  max_depth = 4,
  min_child_weight = 3,
  gamma = 0,
  subsample = 0.3,
  colsample_bytree = 0.7
)

watchlist <- list(train = dtrain, test = dtest)

model_xgb <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 300,
  watchlist = watchlist,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,
  print_every_n = 20
)
```

```{r}
pred_train <- predict(model_xgb, dtrain)
pred_test  <- predict(model_xgb, dtest)

pred <- c(pred_train, pred_test)
actual <- c(y_train, y_test)

mean((pred_test - as.numeric(y_test))^2)
```

```{r}
eval <- model_xgb$evaluation_log

plot(eval$iter, eval$train_rmse, type = "l", col = "#1f77b4", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Boosting Round", ylab = "RMSE",
     main = "XGBoost Training and Test RMSE Over Boosting Rounds", font.main = 1, bty = "l")

lines(eval$iter, eval$test_rmse, col = "#d62728", lwd = 2)

legend("topright", legend = c("Training RMSE", "Validation RMSE"),
       col = c("#1f77b4", "#d62728"), lwd = 2, bty = "n", horiz = TRUE, inset = 0, xpd = TRUE)
```

```{r}
df_xgb <- data.frame(
  iter = eval$iter,
  train_mse = eval$train_rmse^2,
  test_mse  = eval$test_rmse^2
)

ggplot(df_xgb, aes(x = iter)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = train_mse, color = "Training MSE"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = test_mse,  color = "Validation MSE"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Training MSE"   = "#1f77b4",
      "Validation MSE" = "#d62728"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Boosting Round",
    y = "MSE",
    color = "",
    title = "GBDT Training and Validation MSE Over Boosting Rounds"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text()
  )
```

```{r}
max <- 0
days <- 0
for (lag in 1:365) {
  r <- cor(lancet$pm2.5[1:(nrow(lancet) - lag)], lancet$estpos[(lag + 1):nrow(lancet)])
  if (r > max) {
    max <- r
    days <- lag
  }
}
max; days
```
